TEXT: [FI] As the end of July came closer, the true face of summer approached.
[FI] In this heat, Manami and I were heading somewhere.
[FI] "Chiba's 8000 Fireworks Display". How many years has it been, since the last time I went to see fireworks?
[FI] On top of that, trying to find a good spot to watch them...
[FI] Well, that's what a typical "summer date" is all about.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyouu-chaan, Wait! Wait!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, am I walking too fast?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] You are～. It's difficult to walk that fast in geta sandals!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sorry, sorry. So, let me hold that for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hmm, it's fine, I can carry it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's dangerous if you trip when your hands are full!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I won't trip, so it's fine!
[FI] She's holding on to the yakisoba we bought earlier as well as her purse. Is she going to be okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It probably would have been better to go for something more comfortable.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ehhhhhh? The yukata... Doesn't suit me? Boo...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's not that, it's hard to walk in right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hm... a little, yes. Hehehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] But, I really wanted to wear one!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You do?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I do～ So cute, after all～

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...The yukata I mean!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha, I know.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Geez...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If that's the case, shouldn't we have just gone to the beach?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] What do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Cause swimsuits are cute too.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] T-That's true but...
[FI] It was when we talked about where to go this summer.
[FI] Of course it had to be the sea, or the pool. And I'm not saying that because of all the hotties in swimsuits!
[FI] At that time, Manami's denial was a sight to behold.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan! Fireworks are better!
[FI] I didn't think she'd speak up so vehemently. Though I have nothing against fireworks.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] B-But I cant! 'Cause... 'Cause you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] 'Cause?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Because I am... plump...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Plump? Ahh, you're talking about your stomach.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Buhh...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Stupid Kyou-chan!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't get so angry～!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Fuua. I need to get cuter...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Earlier, I even ate a candy apple... And after Kyou-chan said "Let's do our best"... I still have a long way to go to be the "future" me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's not true. You simply have to set a goal for yourself!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] *glare*

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan, I'm going to say something that might be mean, but, what about you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ugh...
[FI] Yeah, that's true. After we contacted the Tamura household and cleared up the misunderstanding, something else happened.
[FI] That is, I too, am aiming to be the "future" Kousaka Kyousuke.
[FI] But, as a goal it's so vague I have no clue where to start! Well, I guess that's the same thing Manami's going through.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, Ma-Manami-san! The fireworks are about to start! Don't space out!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Y-You're changing the subject!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Manami! Watch out! Close your eyes!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Ohe?!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Manami, earlier you ate a candy apple right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Huh, yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You still have some here.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyo...Kyou-cha...n

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well then, let's watch the fireworks!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ky...ou...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] G-GEEEEEEEEZZZZ!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Uowaaaa!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Stupid... Kyou-chan!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Heh... angry again.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Y-You're different than earlier. Seriously Kyou-chan...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] All of a sudden...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] That's... That's...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's because you had pieces of candy apple on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] That has absolutely nothing to do with it!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Doing that... Not doing it suddenly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What the heck are you talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Bu-... awww... You jerk.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're getting angry for no reason.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I'm not! W-Why so suddenly, doing something like that... Ki-Ki...Ki...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] The candy apple? It stuck right there.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] But, Kyou-chan... Well, err... Ki...ss....

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I just couldn't ignore it there, sitting on your lips like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Well, sure, but... The candy apple, if, if you had just told me...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] O-On... The lips... Awwww!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey hey, the fireworks just started! If you get yourself worked up so much, you'll miss them!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] O-Ohh. That's right...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Okay, look up!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan. If you do something weird again I'll get angry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah yeah, there's no candy apple pieces left, so you're safe.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Geez!
[FI] The fireworks illuminated Manami's profile with a rainbow of colors.
[FI] Yeah, it's the face I've seen so many times before. But, seeing it like this... it's been a while.
[FI] Manami, isn't she cute? And not just when she's wearing a yukata or having fun at a festival. Maybe I'll tell her this, some time...
